questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 4 - 6
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) - and =

Given equation is : 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 4 - 6 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 9 ÷ 3 + 7 - 4 = 6

⇒ __**9 ÷ 3**__ + 7 - 4 = 6

⇒ __**3 + 7**__ - 4 = 6

⇒ __**10 - 4**__ = 6

⇒ **6 = 6**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) ÷ and -

Given equation is : 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 4 - 6 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 9 - 3 + 7 = 4 ÷ 6

⇒ 9 - 3 + 7 = __**4 ÷ 6**__

⇒ __**9**__ - 3 __**+ 7**__ = 0.66

⇒ __**16**____** - 3**__ = 0.66

⇒ 13 ≠ 0.66

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) + and -

Given equation is : 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 4 - 6 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 9 ÷ 3 - 7 = 4 + 6

⇒ __**9 ÷ 3**__ - 7 = 4 + 6

⇒ 3 - 7 = __**4 + 6**__

⇒ __**3 - 7**__ = 10

⇒ - 4 ≠ 10

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷ and =

Given equation is : 9 ÷ 3 + 7 = 4 - 6 

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 9 = 3 + 7 ÷ 4 - 6

⇒ 9 = 3 + __**7 ÷ 4**__ - 6

⇒ 9 = __**3 + 1.75**__ - 6

⇒ 9 = __**4.75 - 6**__

⇒ 9 ≠ - 1.25

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"- and =".**

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row- 7, 9, 63

Second row- 6, 8, 48

Third row- 5, 7, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Third number = First number × Second number 

First row- 7, 9, 63 → 7 × 9 = 63

and

Second row- 6, 8, 48 → 6 × 8 = 48

Similarly,

Third row- 5, 7, ? → **5 × 7 = 35**

Hence, the correct answer is **"35".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some cars are fast.

Some fast are slow.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are not slow.

II. Some slow are fast.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c015aeef8dcdc372c5f2d6601c73c987ffbb0476c00a3b5e45de0876ca196b95.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cars are not slow → False (
As Some cars are fast and Some fast are slow so, Some cars are not slow is false)

II. Some slow are fast → True (As Some fast are slow so, Some slow are fast is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

9 and 7

I. 7 × 3 - 8 ÷ 4 + 9 = 32

II. 7 - 9 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 = -3
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

I. Given equation : 7 × 3 - 8 ÷ 4 + 9 = 32

After interchanging the given two numbers 9 and 7 the equation is as follows : 9 × 3 - 8 ÷ 4 + 7 = 32

⇒ 9 × 3 - __**8 ÷ 4**__ + 7 = 32

⇒ __**9 × 3**__ - 2 + 7 = 32

⇒ __**27**__ - 2 __**+ 7**__ = 32

⇒ __**34 - 2**__ = 32

⇒ **32 = 32**

**LHS = RHS**

II. Given equation : 7 - 9 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 = -3 

After interchanging the given two symbols + and ÷ the equation is as follows : 9 - 7 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3 = -3

⇒ 9 - 7 × 2 + __**6 ÷ 3**__ = -3

⇒ 9 - __**7 × 2**__ + 2 = -3

⇒ __**9**__ - 14 __**+ 2**__ = -3

⇒ __**11**____** - 14**__ = -3

⇒ **-3 = -3**

**LHS = RHS**

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither I nor II****".**

questions.question: Seven people K, B, M, C, R, P and S have different heights. C is taller than K. B is shorter than M. P is shorter than M and B. C is not taller than P. S is not taller than K. M is shorter than only one person. Who is the shortest?
questions.solution:
Seven people K, B, M, C, R, P and S have different heights.

1) C is taller than K and C is not taller than P.

P > C > K

2) P is shorter than M and B and B is shorter than M.

M > B > P > C > K

3) S is not taller than K and M is shorter than only one person.

R > M > B > P > C > K > S

∴ Here, 'S' is the shortest.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and fourth number is related to third number.

4 : 25 :: 6 : 49 :: 8 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number + 1)² = Second number

(Third number + 1)² = Fourth number

(Fifth number + 1)² = Sixth number

 
• 4 : 25 → (4 + 1)² = 5² = 25

and

 
• 6 : 49 → (6 + 1)² = 7² = 49

Similarly,

 
• **8 : ? → (8 + 1)² = 9² = 81**

Hence, the correct answer is **"81".**
